children: KKR is redeploying proceeds from the USI sale and expects three acquisitions to replace its earnings by 2030. It sees growth in private wealth, asset-based finance, AI infrastructure and insurance.
KKR and RWE finalized financing for £12 billion in UK offshore wind projects with 2.8 GW capacity. Construction is slated to start in early 2027, with operations expected in 2030.
KKR and partners are exploring a sale of STT Global Data Centres India at a valuation above $5.5 billion. Its 34 data centres across 10 cities have 613 megawatts of capacity.
KKR’s K-Series private wealth assets under management rose 55% year over year to about $45 billion. Revised reporting puts incentive compensation at 15%–20% of revenue, versus 70%–80% previously.
KKR said Arctos integration is ahead of plan, six months after closing. The firm is raising capital for its third sports strategy fund and may launch a GP-led secondary strategy in 2027.
Samsung Fire & Marine Insurance agreed to acquire the remaining 60% stake in Canopius alongside funds managed by KKR & Co Inc (KKR) and Korea Investment Corporation.

• Evercore ISI maintained its Outperform rating on KKR & Co Inc (KKR) and raised its price target to $115 from $109. RBC Capital also maintained an Outperform rating, keeping its price target at $134.
